theme: An open day, with a couple of clocks ticking.
greeting: The whole day is yours, Dan — nothing on the calendar. It's the open stretch the travel backlog has been waiting for, and two of those items have deadlines closing this week.

needsAttention.title: Decide the December family trip
needsAttention.detail: The shortlist-and-book task is past due and the booking window closes Oct 15 — holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year, so this is the one to close first.

needsAttention.title: Hold the Maine Christmas rental
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority task to book a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week has slipped since September; it's the rental most likely to sell out, and a refundable hold costs nothing.

needsAttention.title: Pick a date with Eugenia
needsAttention.detail: She's back from Morocco Oct 31 and asked you to put a catch-up slot on the calendar — you'd floated seeing her around ICGN in Toronto, so a proposed date would close the loop.

flagged.title: New policy role in your alert
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced 'SVP Global Public Policy' and similar openings this morning.

flagged.title: Fran's lunch still needs a spot
flagged.detail: You floated Miyake or Isa Bistro for Friday's 12:30 — she's happy either way, just pick one.

flagged.title: Tampa Gardens hasn't replied
flagged.detail: Your Oct 7 follow-up about your mom's care form is still unanswered — worth a nudge if it's time-sensitive.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — LinkedIn, NYT Cooking, Airbnb, a Toronto hotel deal, and a sailing class reminder for tomorrow.

resolved.title: Maine ferry tickets are set
resolved.detail: The confirmation came through this morning and you forwarded it to Mike — nothing left to do there.

recipe.title: Apple Butterscotch Tart
recipe.why: Autumn's first apples and butterscotch warmth make this a fitting end to a cooling-weather day.

acts.line: A clear calendar — no meetings reach into the morning.
The open stretch runs straight through; it's the kind of afternoon the planning backlog has been waiting for.
With the girls still at Jen's and tomorrow starting early at nine, the evening can stay calm and end early.
